newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines Feb load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines Feb load factor rises.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said on Thursday that its load factor in February increased to 60.1 percent from 59.2 percent in February 1996.

Revenue passenger miles in February increased to 1.98 billion from 1.83 billion in the year ago period, Southwest said. Available seat miles increased to 3.29 billion in February from 3.09 billion in February 1996, the carrier said.
The company's year-to-date load factor increased to 60.1 percent from 56.4 percent in the 1996 year-to-date period, Southwest said.
Southwest's year-to-date available seat miles increased 8.8 percent to 6.87 billion from 6.31 billion a year ago, the carrier said.
Revenue passenger miles increased to $4.13 billion in the year-to-date period from 3.56 billion in the 1996 year-to-date period, Southwest said.
